import sys,json,collections
from pathlib import Path
d=Path(sys.argv[1])
m=json.loads((d/'_probe/diff-review.json').read_text())
seen=collections.Counter()
classes={'C':'convergent','A':'convergent','D':'divergence','Q':'convergent-hole','H':'pass-B-blind-spot'}
out=[]
for row in (d/'part-b-blind.md').read_text().splitlines():
 cells=[s.strip() for s in row.split('|')[1:-1]]
 if len(cells)!=4 or cells[0] in ['id','---']:continue
 k,s,b,_=cells
 cls,*args=m[k][seen[k]].split(':',2)
 seen[k]+=1
 note=args[1] if len(args)>1 else ("The blind pass flags the same intent gap." if cls=='Q' else "Agrees for the named condition; scope and citations are in the corresponding matrix cell or pair trace.")
 if cls=='A':note="vocabulary-drift. "+note
 if args:note+=" (Q-"+args[0]+")."
 out.append('| '+' | '.join([k,s,b,classes[cls],note])+' |')
assert dict(seen)=={k:len(v) for k,v in m.items()}
with (d/'part-b-diff.md').open('a') as f:
 f.write('\n'.join(out)+'\n')
print(len(out),dict(collections.Counter(row.split(' | ')[3] for row in out)))
